items.title: Healthcare Investing Is Now an AI Short in Disguise
items.summary: For years, healthcare and semiconductor stocks weren’t particularly tied to each other.  In other words, they increasingly go in opposite directions: when chips sell off, healthcare has tended to catch a bid.  After years of underperformance, healthcare investors are enjoying a burst of momentum amid the recent nervousness around AI.
